facts.text: Notice of appeal: DBI issuance on 2025-07-01 of an Alteration Permit (correction to NOV No. 202536052: exterior deck scope; repair part of NW corner low wall; remove existing non-fire-rated lattice on top of exterior low wall; new rainwater leader/scupper) at 50 Scenic Way; application 2025/05/29/7531; hearing 2025-08-27.
Permit scope text repeats 'REMOVE (E) NON-FIRE RATED LATTICE ON TOP OF EXTERIOR LOW WALL' and lists Occupancy Code R-3.
Appellant says the permit 'completely disregards item number 2' of the NOV, which the appellant says concerns damage the owner was shown (appellant's claim).
Image-only permit-set cover sheet A0.0 for 50 Scenic Way, with a demolition key note for the lattice on the exterior low wall and a received stamp that appears dated 2025-05-29 (low-resolution read).

Board minutes 2025-08-27, Item (6): 'the Board voted 4-0 to grant the appeal and issue the permit on the condition it be revised to require that Item No. 2 of Notice of Violation No. 202536052 is addressed, more specifically repair the damaged garage level wall below the deck.'
The minutes record the basis for the motion: the revision 'will be Code compliant and meet the full requirements of the Notice of Violation that was issued.'
